description: Implementation of a logical AND criteria in a query model, specifically the AndCriteriaImpl class that combines multiple criteria using logical AND logic.

classes.name: AndCriteriaImpl
classes.description: Represents a composite criterion that performs a logical AND over a list of subordinate criteria.

methods.name: AndCriteriaImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AndCriteriaImpl with a list of criteria, requiring non-nullity.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a CriteriaVisitor and applies it to each subordinate criterion, returning the visitor's result.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare AndCriteriaImpl instances based on their list of criteria.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate a hash based on the criteria list.
